title: LORD, REVEAL HIDDEN SOLUTIONS TO COMPLEX PROBLEMS
text: Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Glory to God. Glory to God. Glory to God. We give you praise this morning. We give you honor. We give you adoration. Ancient of days. The one who sits upon the circle of the earth. The one who inhabits eternity. The one whose understanding is unsearchable and whose ways are pass finding out. Father, we worship you this morning. We exalt your name. There is no name like your name. There is no wisdom like your wisdom. Father, we have come before you this morning not because we are perfect, [music] not because we have it all together, but because you are God and you are the answer to every question that life has ever raised against us. So, Father, receive our worship, receive our praise, let the atmosphere be charged. Let every spirit that is not of you be silenced. Let every distraction be removed. And let your presence fill this place in the name of Jesus. Now, listen to me this morning. I need you to shake somebody's hand and tell them times God has hidden the answer inside this moment. Go ahead, tell somebody. God has hidden the answer inside this moment. You did not stumble upon this prayer by accident. There are no accidents in the kingdom of God. The same spirit that orchestrated the parts of the wisest men who ever lived. The same spirit that caused Solomon to ask for wisdom and received it. That spirit has gathered you this morning for a reason. Receive it in your spirit. I want to speak to you from the treasury of the spirit this morning. And the word I bring is these times. Lord, reveal hidden solutions to complex problems. [music] Say it after me. Lord, reveal hidden solutions to complex problems. Now, let that prayer sit in your spirit for a moment. Don't rush past it because there is something very significant about the word times hidden. Hidden does not mean absent. Hidden does not mean unavailable. Hidden does not mean that God forgot about your situation. Hidden means God placed it somewhere for you. And this morning, he's about to show you where. In Proverbs 25 and verse two, the scripture says, "It is the glory of God to conceal a matter, but the glory of kings to search it out." I need somebody to hear this. The glory of God is in concealment. God is not being cruel when he hides things. God is not being difficult. There is a glory embedded in the concealment itself. The treasure was hidden not to frustrate you but to refine you. The solution was hidden not to break you but to build you. The answer is hidden not because God doesn't care but because God cares so much that he wants to develop in you the capacity to carry what he's about to reveal. Are you hearing me this morning? Look at Job. Here is a man in catastrophic crisis. His children are gone. His health has collapsed. His business empire is in ruins. His wife has turned against him. His friends are counseledled without revelation. And Job is sitting on ashes scraping his wounds with broken potry. And yet in the midst of that in chapter 23 and:e 10, Job opens his mouth and says, "But he knows the way that I take." I need you to feel that. In the middle of Job's most complex problem, the most devastating season of his entire existence, he made a declaration that would become one of the most powerful prophetic statements in all of scripture. He said, "God [music] knows the way." When nobody else knew the way. When the path was not visible, when the solution was hidden from every natural eye, Job said, "He knows." That is what I want to build in your spirit this morning. God knows the way that you take. Your case is not confused in heaven. The father is not scratching his head, looking at your situation, wondering what to do. In Isaiah 46:10, it says, "Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times, things that are not yet done, saying, my counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure." God saw the end of your problem before your problem began. He already had the solution prepared before the crisis arrived. So this morning when we pray, Lord, reveal hidden solutions to complex problems. We are not begging a reluctant God. We are activating a willing father. We are pulling on a covenant that has already been sealed with blood. Now I want to go deeper with you this morning. There are three kinds of hidden solutions that God can reveal. Write this somewhere in your spirit. The first one is times structural solutions. These are solutions hidden in systems, in knowledge, in information. The second kind times relational solutions. hidden in people, in connections, in divine appointments that haven't happened yet. And the third kind, time, spiritual solutions, hidden in revelation, in prayer, in obedience, in a specific act of faith that when you take it, everything [music] shifts. And this morning, God is about to pull back the curtain on all three. This is not a light moment. This is a moment of unveiling. Let me show you something about Daniel. In Daniel chapter 2, Nebuchadnezzar has a dream. A complex problem. Not just complex, it is a times deadly times problem. Because this king has made a decree that if nobody can tell him both the dream and its interpretation, every wise man in Babylon will be executed. And Daniel is on that list. The Chaldians [music] have no answer. The magicians have no answer. The astrologers have no answer. Human wisdom has exhausted itself against this problem. And what does Daniel do? Daniel 21:17:18 says, he goes to his companions and they seek mercy from the God of heaven concerning this secret. And then in verse 19, then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a night vision. Can you see it? The same night he prayed, the same night God answered. The problem that stormed the entire intellectual system of Babylon was solved in one night of prayer. That is the God we serve. I'm talking to somebody this morning whose problem has stormed everybody around them. Your advisors are exhausted. Your lawyers are confused. Your doctors are uncertain. Your consultants have run out of options. Every human framework has been applied to your situation and come back empty. I want you to hear me. What Daniel discovered is that the God of heaven is not limited by the same limitations that restrict human intelligence. When God reveals the revelation is complete. When God shows you the way, the path is clear. In John 11, there is a situation that looks absolutely hopeless. I need you to understand something [music] this morning. The solution was already there. The victory was already positioned. The answer had already been deployed. What was missing was not resources. Lord, reveal what you have already [music] prepared. Lord, let us see what is already present in the realm of the spirit. The solutions to our complex problems are not somewhere far away. They are not in some distant future waiting to arrive. They are present hidden in the council of God, hidden in realms that the natural eye cannot access. Why not just study more? Why not just work harder? Why not just think more strategically? And I want to address that with the full weight of scripture. 1 Corinthians 2:9-10 says, "I has not seen nor ear heard nor have entered into the heart of man the things which God has prepared for those who love him, but God has revealed them to us through his [music] spirit." Did you catch that? The solutions that God has prepared, they cannot be accessed through the natural channels of perception. You cannot see them with physical eyes. You cannot hear them with natural ears. You cannot think your way into them through human reasoning alone. They are revealed through the spirit. And the spirit operates in the context of prayer, worship, surrender, and seeking. This is why Daniel prayed. This is why Solomon asked. This is why Elijah prayed. This is why Paul says in Ephesians 1:17 that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the father of glory, may give to you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him. Wisdom and revelation, two distinct things. Wisdom is the ability to rightly apply what you know. But revelation is the capacity to receive what you don't yet know from the one who knows everything. And this morning, by the authority of the Holy Spirit, I am releasing both over your life. Now I want to speak to someone specifically. You have been working on a problem. Maybe a business problem, maybe a health problem, maybe a financial engineering problem, maybe a technological challenge, maybe a family situation. And you have applied every framework you know. You have read every book. You have consulted every expert. You have Googled every possible combination of words related to the issue and still the answer eludes you. Let me tell you what God is saying to you this morning. The answer to what you are seeking is not in another book. It's not in another consultant. It's not in another country or another city. The answer is going to come to you the same way it came to Jacob in a night vision. The same way it came to Joseph in [music] a dream. The same way it came to Solomon in a moment of encounter with God. When you stop performing and start seeking, God will speak. Jeremiah 33:3, one of the most explosive promises in all of scripture. God says, "Call to me and I will answer you [music] and show you great and mighty things which you do not know."
